tailLossBehavior: This local one-key projection requires the exact positively installed issuer anchor, complete immutable partition baseline, and complete SQL-registered post-baseline reservation set. Existing baseline fields must all remain present and exact. A locally registered pending field may be absent or exact; a completed SQL issuer-local release may appear only as its retained exact RELEASED capacity postimage with its binding absent. The physical owner mutates only the target original capacity field and its SQL-qualified target binding field. Missing baseline/header, legacy or malformed values, unknown fields, current source or incarnation movement, or incomplete SQL accounting leaves the operation unqualified. The result is physical readback evidence only; it does not acknowledge issuer-wide coverage, open a barrier, or authorize admission.
